column1: # Object budget allowlist, read by scripts/check_object_budget.py (gate 0 and
# scripts/hooks/pre-push): the exact census of the files over 1 MiB, one row
# per file, path<TAB>blob<TAB>bytes. Seeded 2026-11-15 from main.
# A row grants nothing by itself. A commit that introduces a blob over 1 MiB
# (a new large file, or any edit of one) carries that blob's exact row here
# in its own tree AND the trailer `Object-Budget: <path>: <reason>` in its
# message; the check refuses either missing. At the range's tip every row
# must be exactly the tip's file, so remove a row when its file goes or
# shrinks under the budget. Rewrite the rows from the staged tree with
# Generated evidence never qualifies: it belongs in the external evidence
